correctness.rationale: For K_{m1,...,ms}, s>=2, 2<=r<=N-1, the face set consists of every set of <=r vertices and all sets in one part. Thus X is full (r-1)-skeleton plus part simplices. Augmented simplex chain C_{r-1}=Λ^r Z^V, boundary contraction with augmentation, and relative attachments produce an exact sequence ⊕_i Λ^r L_i -> Λ^r L -> H_{r-1}(X;Z) -> 0 with no other reduced homology. Choice of one vertex per part exhibits ⊕L_i as direct summand of L with complement Z^{s-1}, hence the exterior-power quotient is torsion-free and has the stated binomial rank. Natural maps are equivariant under all graph automorphisms; determinant cycle products give the full character. Over Q, within-part invariants are Λ^r Q^{s-1} (dimension binom(s-1,r)) and part exchanges act by standard S_s exterior power with no positive-degree fixed vectors. Quotient rational homology equals invariants after barycentric subdivision. Small-case independently reconstructed face enumeration/Euler checks corroborate the formula.
